Title: Aarav and the Family

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Siya - 11 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Pallavi - 38 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Siya and Pallavi stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Siya, what's the plan today?"

[Aarav does push-ups.]

Siya: "Aarav, listen!"

[Aarav does yoga on a mat.]

Aarav: "This is amazing!"

[Siya skips rope.]

Siya: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Aarav: "This is amazing!"

[Flower petals rain down on Aarav.]

Aarav: "And then?"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Aarav (laughing): "That's great!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Pallavi and Siya stand near him.]

Pallavi: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav eats his breakfast at the table.]

Siya: "And then?"

[Aarav takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Aarav: "One more time!"

[Aarav munches on an apple.]

Aarav: "That's easy."

[Aarav drinks a glass of water.]

Siya (gently): "Exactly right."

[Aarav sips hot tea from a cup.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

[Aarav gulps down a glass of milk.]

Aarav: "Siya, are you okay?"

[Aarav serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Aarav: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
